description: This file implements a timer management system in C, including creation, destruction, insertion, updating, removal, and retrieval of timers, with internal linked list management and thread safety mechanisms.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a timer object with specified quantity and thread safety options.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a timer object, freeing allocated memory.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_obj_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a timer object is valid based on its identifier.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new timer with specified timeout, handler, and data into the timer object.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_update
methods.description: Updates the timeout of an existing timer.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_update_handler
methods.description: Updates the timeout, handler, and data of an existing timer.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_remove
methods.description: Removes a timer from the timer object.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_next_get
methods.description: Retrieves the next timer's timeout as timeval, handler, and data.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_next_get_ts
methods.description: Retrieves the next timer's timeout as timespec, handler, and data.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_list_add
methods.description: Adds a timer to the internal linked list in order based on timeout.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_list_remove
methods.description: Removes a timer from the internal linked list.
